whisper.transcript: They fired a laser into a thunderstorm, and the lightning followed it! You see, air normally resists the flow of electricity. But this machine fired a thousand laser pulses every second, stripping electrons from air molecules and heating a narrow channel through the sky. That gave electricity an easier path to travel. So when lightning erupted upward from a nearby tower. Part of the bolt followed that channel for over 160 feet. A normal lightning rod only reaches as high as its metal tip. But these scientists extended one into the sky. using the air itself.
